title: Tool capability guide: expose all 33 implemented tools with descriptions, when to use them, and what findings they produce
goal: AegisPT has 33 implemented runner tools (nmap, nuclei, zap, burp, metasploit, netexec, impacket, bloodhound, responder, ldap-enum, snmp-enum, mdns-ssdp, ipv6-discovery, aws-inventory, semgrep, playwright-web, credential-attacks, hashcat, llm-probe, camera-test, iot-default-creds, smart-home, api-assessment, biz-logic-probe, mobile-android, cloud-native, cicd-security, desktop-client, network-segmentation, ssh-audit, easm-discover, external-infra, httpx). Operators do not know this. Add a 'Tool Library' view (accessible from the Pack Forge screen or as a tab in Settings) that shows: (1) Grid of all tools with: name, icon, category (Discovery / Web / Credential / Lateral Movement / Specialized), short description (one sentence), typical findings it produces, required authorization tier (passive/active/intrusive/exploitation). (2) For each tool: click to see detailed view with example findings, required prerequisites (e.g. metasploit needs intrusive gate), and which assessment modes include it automatically. (3) Quick-add button: 'Add to current run' — creates a manual task proposal for operator approval. This turns the tool list from internal documentation into an operator-facing capability catalogue.
scope: Code audit 2026-05-03: workers/orchestration/tasks.py lines 158-191 lists all 33 supported tools. Operators see none of this. The wizard tiles (10 tiles) give a high-level choice but don't explain which of 33 tools runs for each tile or why. Enterprise operators want to know exactly what is being tested.
generation_reason: 33 implemented tools are invisible to operators — need an in-app tool catalogue so operators understand and can directly invoke capabilities.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Display existing tool capabilities. Do not add new tools or change tool dispatch logic.

success_criteria: Tool Library view accessible from Pack Forge or Settings.
All 33 tools shown with name, category, description, and auth tier.
Clicking a tool shows detailed view with findings, prerequisites, chain membership.
'Add to run' button creates a manual task proposal.
No regression in packs/runs E2E tests.

acceptance_criteria: Each tool has description and auth tier.
